verdict:
**Not clean — 2 issues found:**

1. **Clipped/overlapping UI (bottom center):** The text “Skip - use default yard” (y≈740) collides with the scale bar (“10 ft”) and the “Sun” toggle — the “Sun” label is half-buried behind the skip text. The skip option also appears to belong inside the wizard modal, not floating over the bottom toolbar; it should sit next to “← Back” inside the modal.

2. **Ambiguous label:** The bottom toolbar button “Innovate” is unclear — it doesn’t match the tool verb pattern of its neighbors (Tape Measure, Terrain, Excavate, Analyze) and a new user won’t guess what it does.

**Minor/no-action:** The onboarding modal (Step 2 of 2) is legible and self-explanatory, so a new user would understand the screen in ~5 seconds despite background palette noise; the left palette, Getting Started card, compass, and zoom controls don’t overlap anything; sidebar clipping of “Patio” at the fold is normal scroll behavior.
